verifications.claim: The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon is on March 15, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'March 15, 2026'; R3: 'Date 15 March 2026'; R4: 'Sunday, March 15'; R8: 'On March 15, 2026'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm the exact date.

verifications.claim: The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon is a 13.1-mile point-to-point course.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: '13.1-mile race' from Brooklyn to Central Park; R2: '13.1 miles, starting on Washington Avenue... finishing in Central Park'; R3: '13.1-mile journey... starting in Brooklyn and finishing in Central Park'; R4: '13.1-mile race' from Prospect Park to Central Park
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly state 13.1 miles and describe point-to-point from Brooklyn start to Central Park finish.

verifications.claim: The course starts at Washington Avenue in Brooklyn near the Brooklyn Museum.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'begin on Washington Avenue near the Brooklyn Museum'; R2: 'starting on Washington Avenue near the Brooklyn Museum'; R8: 'corner of Washington Avenue and Sullivan Place'
verifications.reasoning: Direct matches on start location near Brooklyn Museum.

verifications.claim: The course goes through Prospect Park.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'through Prospect Park'; R2: 'through Prospect Park'; R4: 'start in Brooklyn's Prospect Park'; R6: 'kicks off in Brooklyn’s lively Prospect Park'; R8: 'starts at Brooklyn's Prospect Park'

verifications.claim: The course goes along Flatbush Avenue.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: No source describes the course going along Flatbush Avenue; closures mentioned but not route.

verifications.claim: The course crosses the East River via the Brooklyn Bridge.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.reasoning: Majority support Brooklyn Bridge, but R3 explicitly states Manhattan Bridge, creating contradiction.

verifications.claim: The course traverses the FDR Drive.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'along the FDR Drive'; R2: 'along the FDR Drive'; R4: 'go up FDR Drive'; R8: 'East Side of the FDR'

verifications.claim: The course passes near the Lower East Side.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R6: 'through the historic Lower East Side'; R8: 'into Lower Manhattan'
verifications.reasoning: R6 directly supports passing through Lower East Side; R8 implies proximity.

verifications.claim: The course goes through Times Square.
verifications.label: CLEAR

verifications.claim: The race finishes in Central Park at 72nd Street and West Drive.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: R8: 'finishing at 72nd Street and West Drive'; R1: 'finish in Central Park near West 68th Street'
verifications.reasoning: R8 supports exact location; R1 contradicts with different street (68th).

verifications.claim: The first wave starts at 7 a.m.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: R1/R2: 'first wave... at 7:20 a.m.'; R4: 'first runners... at 7 a.m.'; R8: 'approximately 7 A.M.'
verifications.reasoning: Sources contradict on exact time (7:20 vs. 7 a.m.).

verifications.claim: The course includes steep early climbs over the bridge.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R3: 'notable incline over the Manhattan Bridge early in the course'
verifications.reasoning: R3 mentions incline early on bridge but uses broader 'notable' not 'steep', and specifies different bridge.

verifications.claim: The course includes rolling hills in Central Park.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'rolling segments through the park... undulating terrain in Central Park'
verifications.reasoning: Direct description of rolling/undulating terrain in Central Park.

verifications.claim: Eight aid stations with water and Gatorade are available.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: No mention of aid stations or specifics.

verifications.claim: A gel station is available at mile 8.2.
verifications.label: OMITTED

verifications.claim: Street closures in Brooklyn and Manhattan run from 12:00 a.m. to 11:30 a.m.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R4: Brooklyn some streets '12:00 a.m. – 11:30 a.m.'; Manhattan various times like '4:30 a.m. – 1:00 p.m.'
verifications.reasoning: Partial match for some Brooklyn streets, but not uniform range or for all areas/Manhattan.

verifications.claim: Street closures affect areas like Eastern Parkway.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'Eastern Pkwy. (south service road) from Washington Ave. to Franklin Ave.' etc.
verifications.reasoning: Direct listing of Eastern Pkwy closures.

verifications.claim: Restrictions near the finish last into the afternoon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1/R2: 'finish line will close around 1:30 p.m.'; R4: closures to 1:00-3:00 p.m., no parking to 3 p.m.
verifications.reasoning: Closures and finish restrictions extend past noon into afternoon.

verifications.claim: Participants and spectators can use the NYRR app for live tracking.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'tracked using the NYRR App'; R2: 'track runners using the... NYRR app'; R4: 'NYRR app to track runners'
verifications.reasoning: Direct support for runners and spectators.
